content_of_post_to_answer: How can I focus on my studies and other important things when I’m worried about losing my hair?
answer: The struggle is often not the hair loss itself, but the meaning attached to it. When your mind treats a change in appearance as a threat to your identity, it keeps returning to the problem because it feels unresolved. Try separating two questions: “Can I take reasonable care of this?” and “Do I need to keep thinking about this every hour?” The first deserves action; the second only steals attention. Hair changes can affect confidence, but they do not have to become the measure of your future. A worrying mind turns a physical change into a life sentence; a calmer mind sees it as one part of life that can be handled.
